Method of Attack: Remote access trojan (RAT) enabling remote control of mouse and keyboard
Keylogging to monitor and log key presses
Ransomware deployment with automatic ransom note generation
DDoS attacks by directing garbage traffic using compromised machine resources
Hidden remote desktop for file operations, input device use, code execution, app launching
Reverse proxy setup to protect operator identity
Process hollowing to inject malware code into legitimate processes
Disruptive functions like playing audio, swapping mouse buttons, hiding desktop/taskbar, holding mouse, turning off monitor, showing blank screen, hanging system
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (implied by features like UAC bypass, Chromium-based browsers, microphone, webcam)
Attack Vector: Laced executables or files masquerading as cracks for games and applications
